assertions.value: Current-structure and robot-state embedding into the context consumed by the causal temporal predictor
assertions.rationale: An operational encoder maps supplied current observations and completed structure to predictor context. This is not an end-to-end demonstration of estimating the initial skeleton from raw video; the current skeleton is a supplied input.

assertions.value: Wan video encoding/tokenization and learned structural-control encoders
assertions.rationale: The architecture uses encoded reference/video latents and structural-control features in both generator alternatives. Encoder existence is supported; encoder-specific effectiveness and adaptation are separate questions.

criteria_met: The operative pipeline names Wan 2.2 encoder components and a reused Wan tokenizer.
Teacher initialization from Cosmos-H DiT and zero-initialized structural-control outputs are described.
The student retains the structural interface through teacher-to-student distillation.
criteria_missing: The exact encoder/tokenizer checkpoint and its frozen-versus-updated parameter treatment are not sufficiently specified.
assertions.rationale: Named reused components are part of SurgCast, not merely comparison baselines. The Cosmos-H DiT initialization is backbone reuse and does not alone establish the provenance or adaptation of every observation-encoder parameter.

The structural predictor's embedding and transformer architecture are described without a named pretrained encoder checkpoint. Upstream SurgPose detections are supplied inputs, not evidence that SurgPose parameters initialize the structural predictor. Training from scratch is not explicitly established.

Equation (6) explicitly trains conditional rectified-flow velocity matching on encoded video latents. This establishes latent generative training, but not unambiguously a context-to-target representation-learning objective in the feature's JEPA-style sense. Resolution requires clarifying whether latent denoising/velocity targets alone satisfy this feature; no separate predictive representation loss is reported. A latent tokenizer alone is not treated as sufficient.

assertions.value: Teacher-trajectory warm-start regression to clean future-video latent endpoints
assertions.rationale: The explicitly described warm start predicts a clean future representation against a teacher-trajectory endpoint without requiring decoded-observation reconstruction for that objective. Presence is limited to this training subobjective; it does not establish JEPA encoder pretraining, a learned target encoder, anti-collapse validation or a separately measured benefit from the warm start.

assertions.value: No latent-target representation term in the specified structural-predictor objective
assertions.rationale: The complete reported predictor loss comprises coordinate, coordinate-displacement, visibility and current-keypoint-completion terms. These supervise explicit structural observations, not target latent representations. Internal embeddings do not change those target semantics. This scoped absence concerns the specified predictor training loss, not an undocumented pretraining history or the video student's latent endpoint loss.

No explicit representation anti-collapse constraint, target-encoder regularization argument or collapse test is reported. Zero-initialized control projections preserve the starting backbone function, and the frozen skeleton predictor supplies controls; neither is documented as a representation-collapse prevention mechanism. No collapsed representation is reported either.

assertions.value: Current-keypoint completion loss on artificially masked observed coordinates
assertions.rationale: The completion subobjective reconstructs masked current structural observations using Smooth-L1 and is weighted in the joint predictor loss. This is reconstruction of observed keypoint values, not an image-autoencoding loss. No isolated completion-accuracy or reconstruction-ablation result is reported.

assertions.value: No decoded-observation reconstruction term in the specified teacher-training objective
assertions.rationale: The fully specified teacher objective in Equation (6) matches rectified-flow velocity in video-latent space. It does not compare decoded observed pixels with reconstructed pixels. This mechanism-level absence is restricted to the reported teacher loss; it does not deny video decoding, the structural predictor's completion loss or possible reconstruction objectives used to pretrain the tokenizer.

assertions.value: No observed-image reconstruction term in the specified student distillation objectives
assertions.rationale: The documented warm start targets teacher latent endpoints; subsequent distribution matching and auxiliary-denoiser training operate on generated latent samples. Reconstructing detached student samples is not reconstructing observed images or measurements against observations. This assessment concerns these specified training objectives only.

This separate assessment concerns pretraining of the reused Wan observation encoder/tokenizer. Encoder and decoder components are named, but their pretraining reconstruction losses are not specified in SurgCast. Such objectives are not inherited from familiarity with the cited model family.

The implemented chain combines reference-image appearance with structural observations and robot-state/action information through the skeleton predictor and video conditioning. Geometry maps and kinematic descriptors are two transformations of the same skeleton, not two independently acquired modalities. This assertion concerns implemented fusion, not a separately validated missing-modality capability.

The student retains reference-image, native-action and predicted-structural conditioning. Its causal video-history attention does not remove the supplied prospective control window. The teacher's structural-path ablation is not assigned to the student as a separate fusion-ablation result.

The shared predictor design embeds image-space instrument structure together with measured robot state into a current-context vector, then combines that context with prospective commands. This is fusion of visual-structural and robot-state information. The grouped scope records a common mechanism, not shared weights or pooled H12/H72 results.

Absence is confined to this documented structural-state mechanism.

The video methods specify stochastic predictive generation and, for the student, generated-history conditioning. They do not sufficiently describe an observation-history-conditioned posterior belief over hidden surgical state with stated filtering uncertainty semantics. Predictive image sampling alone does not establish this feature.

scope.time_horizon: Within the evaluated fixed-origin supplied-action prediction windows only

assertions.rationale: The complete scoped prediction procedure starts from observed current inputs and generates future structure/video without a subsequent measured-observation correction operation. Student feedback consists of generated latents. Initial keypoint completion is not a distinct propagate-then-correct filter. This negative applies to the evaluated window algorithm, not to all possible future interface extensions.

scope.time_horizon: Within a supplied prediction window, after its initial observation

assertions.rationale: The scoped algorithm forecasts from a fixed observed origin and prospective commands; later real scene measurements are not assimilated within that forecast. Autoregressive generated video and operator-supplied action alternatives are not arriving measured evidence. The conclusion explicitly leaves continuous-feedback testing to future work; no system-wide impossibility of later assimilation is inferred.

No rule for adapting individual patient- or case-specific parameters from newly arriving measurements is described. The H12 domain-adapted predictors are domain-level configurations, not patient-specific fitting. A frozen structural predictor during generation is documented, but this does not alone establish an explicit population-wide parameter policy for every component.

Equation (2) applies coordinate and visibility heads to the same predictor representation rather than defining separate state models. This is narrow reuse across two typed structural readouts. It does not establish a reusable clinical patient state, transfer to unrelated tasks, or shared checkpoints between H12 and H72 configurations.

scope.time_horizon: Video-generator latent-state readouts

assertions.rationale: The reported generator task is future-video production. Multiple quality metrics on that output are not multiple state readouts, and alternative teacher/student generators do not establish one shared checkpoint serving different typed tasks. The predictor's coordinate/visibility reuse is recorded separately.

No matched scene/history swap, withheld individual information or generic-prior control is reported that establishes added predictive value from the correct individual scene history. Structural-path and future-action ablations, and branching commands from one initial scene, answer different questions. No actual human-patient personalization study is established.

scope.time_horizon: Fixed instrument/keypoint roles across a finite structural forecast

assertions.rationale: Fixed tool-specific keypoint roles, offsets anchored to the same completed current configuration, and a horizon-consistent jaw-tip target assignment provide explicit structural-consistency mechanisms. This does not establish anatomically valid tissue evolution, perfect cross-tool identity tracking or a successful identity-specific validation test.

scope.time_horizon: Instrument-structure conditioning across the generated future-video block

assertions.rationale: Predicted articulated structure with fixed roles is supplied across the horizon through geometric residuals and derived kinematic conditioning specifically to maintain instrument configuration. This is an implemented consistency-oriented mechanism, not merely visual similarity. GATC/TCD do not by themselves prove persistent semantic identity or tissue/anatomical consistency.

scope.time_horizon: Aligned structural conditioning during autoregressive video generation

assertions.rationale: The student retains the same fixed-role skeleton geometry and motion-semantic interface through distillation. That structural conditioning, rather than the causal attention mask alone, supports this assertion. No guarantee of identity preservation over unbounded rollouts or physical interaction is inferred.

The explicit structural representation maps to five role-defined 2D keypoints per instrument, visibility and named projected shaft/wrist/jaw motion quantities. Forecast skeletons are exposed alongside generated views in the reported branching demonstration. Inspectability is confined to these projected structures and controls, not all hidden activations or calibrated 3D mechanics. No formal user-understanding study is established.

scope.time_horizon: Internal video-latent state, excluding the separately inspectable structural interface

scope.time_horizon: Within the 18-future-latent autoregressive window
